## ✨ About

**Dr. Cat** is a crypto landing page built for a real client.  
It combines a meme-style concept with a structured UI, clear user flow, and optimized performance.

---

## ⚡ Highlights

- Responsive layout across all devices
- Smooth animations and interactive UI
- Tokenomics, FAQ, and onboarding sections
- Copy-to-clipboard functionality
- Optimized performance (PageSpeed 90+)
